topic.label: Mathematical and Computational Science
topic.desc: Mathematical and Computational Science: mathematics, statistics and computing combined to model and analyse data and systems.

concepts: Limits, derivatives, integrals, series and the rigorous foundations of continuous mathematics.
Vector spaces, matrices, eigenvalues and decompositions that underpin data analysis and computation.
Random variables, distributions, estimation, hypothesis testing and Bayesian inference for data.
Algorithms for approximating solutions to continuous problems with controlled error and stability.
Design and analysis of algorithms, complexity, graphs and continuous and discrete optimization.
Statistical learning, model validation and reproducible data pipelines for prediction and discovery.
skills: Computes derivatives, integrals and series expansions symbolically and checks them by differentiation or numeric evaluation.
Writes epsilon-delta and series convergence proofs and has every step checked for valid inference.
Solves ordinary differential equations analytically and checks solutions by substitution and numeric integration.
Computes LU, QR, eigen and SVD decompositions and checks reconstruction error and orthogonality.
Solves overdetermined systems by least squares and checks residuals and conditioning.
Projects data onto principal components and checks explained variance and reconstruction quality.
Selects and runs the appropriate statistical test and checks its assumptions and effect size.
Fits linear and generalised linear models and checks residual diagnostics and out-of-sample error.
Specifies priors and likelihoods, samples posteriors and checks MCMC convergence diagnostics.
Finds roots with bisection, Newton and secant methods and checks residuals and convergence order.
Discretises partial differential equations with finite differences and checks stability conditions and grid convergence.
Analyses rounding and truncation error in a computation and checks results with higher-precision reruns.
Derives time and space complexity of algorithms and checks bounds with empirical runtime scaling.
Runs shortest path, flow and matching algorithms and checks optimality certificates.
Solves convex problems with gradient and interior-point methods and checks KKT conditions at the solution.
Trains models with k-fold cross validation and checks for leakage and overfitting.
Builds and tunes classification models and checks calibration and confusion matrices on held-out data.
Writes SQL and dataframe pipelines over analytic databases and checks row counts and aggregates against source tables.
mcp: Inject precise, real-time computation and knowledge
Model Context Protocol server for symbolic mathematics and computer algebra built on SymPy
Fast search and full-text access over arXiv pre-prints
BigQuery: Advanced analytical insights for agents
Local MCP server for DuckDB and MotherDuck: run SQL, browse catalogs and connect to local DuckDB files, in-memory databases, S3-hosted databases and MotherDuck
